title: athyrium fraxinifolium
intro: Athyrium fraxinifolium, commonly known as the Mountain Woods Fern or Fraxinus-leaved Lady Fern, is a type of fern native to the mountainous regions of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, with reported health benefits including the ability to reduce inflammation and fever, as well as act as an antiseptic to promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium fraxinifolium are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids that have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the properties and potential uses of this plant.
